description: As Alaska continues to bear the brunt of DC-driven energy price hikes, today lifelong Alaskan Mary Peltola announced her plan to bring down energy costs, unleash Alaska oil and gas development, and invest in the future of Alaska energy.

title: Mary Peltola Announces Plan to Make Energy Affordable for Alaskans - Mary Peltola
